sloka: भ्रातरं निहतं दृष्ट्वा रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा।महोदरमहापार्श्वौ शोकाक्रान्तौ बभूवतुः ।। ६.६८.८ ।।
transliteration: bhrātaraṁ nihataṁ dṛṣṭvā rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā।mahodaramahāpārśvau śokākrāntau babhūvatuḥ ।। 6.68.8 ।।

translations.english: Ravana's brothers, Mahodara and Mahaparsva were overtaken by sorrow on hearing about the unwearied action of Rama and slaying of Kumbhakarna.
